name: Odropsy
author: telep
description: Your AI chats in the bar: Muse, ChatGPT Dots and Grok Bot each drop down from the top on a click. Pop one out into a window when you need more room.

barWidget.description: One bar icon per AI app; click to drop it down, click again to tuck it away. Add the widget once per service.

schema.label: Service
schema.description: muse = muse.ai, dots = ChatGPT Dots, grok = the Grok Bot desktop app.

schema.label: URL (empty = service default)
schema.description: Web services only, e.g. your dot's page https://chatgpt.com/dots/<id>.

schema.label: Icon image path (empty = bundled)
schema.description: Absolute or ~/ path to a square PNG.
